⚖️The Smart & Balanced: 🇹🇼 Kaohsiung
👉Why: Safe, tourist-friendly, and easy to travel around. Great hotel prices, but tickets are harder to get because international ARMY love this venue.
🪙 Budget + Best Chance 🇲🇾 Kuala Lumpur
👉Why: Highest stadium capacity (85K) means better chances of getting tickets, plus friendly hotel and travel costs.
💳 Comfort + Big Budget: Singapore🇸🇬 & Hong Kong🇭🇰
👉Why: Top-tier public transport, modern stadiums with roofs, and great social media vibes. Just be ready for expensive hotels.
🎒The Budget but Hardcore: Bulacan🇵🇭
👉Why: Very affordable stay, but a total nightmare for transport. The stadium is far from Manila, so you must prepare for massive traffic and pre-book your rides.
🔥Hardcore: Bangkok🇹🇭
👉Why: Pure "war zone" experience with crazy traffic and hot weather.
